about: plan-sound plus one acceptance criterion that leaves a product choice open: link creation is 'rate limited', with no number, window or scope. A worker would have to invent the limit, and the reviewer couldn't check it. The advisor should ask for the choice to be settled (C5, 'Open choices').

acceptance: POST /schedules/:id/share by the owner returns 201 with a ShareLink whose token is 64 hex characters and whose url is WEB_ORIGIN/share/<token> (api test)
POST /schedules/:id/share returns 401 for an anonymous caller, 403 for a signed-in non-owner and 404 for an unknown schedule, and creates no link in each case (api tests)
GET /share/:token with no credentials returns 200 and schedules.PublicView of the schedule (no owner id); an unknown token returns 404 (api tests)
Only GET is routed for /share/:token: POST to it returns 405 (api test through the real router)
On SchedulePage the owner sees a Share button that calls POST /schedules/:id/share and copies the returned url; anyone else sees no button; an API failure shows an error message (web tests)
The web route /share/:token fetches GET /share/:token and renders the schedule read-only, and shows 'This link doesn't exist' on 404 (web tests)
Creating share links is rate limited, and a caller over the limit gets 429 (api test)
